epic_ed_los_median_{variant}.long_name: Median emergency department length of stay for {variant.short_name} encounters
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}.short_description: Median time in minutes from ED arrival to ED departure for {variant.short_name} encounters.
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}.long_description: Median emergency department length of stay in minutes for {variant.short_name} encounters. Encounters are Epic Cosmos ED encounters with a United States country of residence, attributed to the patient's state of residence and to the calendar quarter of arrival, and assigned to the {variant.short_name} group of the ED Diagnoses grouper. Length of stay runs from arrival to ED departure, so it includes boarding time for patients awaiting an inpatient or psychiatric bed. Cells built on 10 or fewer encounters are suppressed at source. In these cases, length of stay is left missing and the suppression flag is 1. The 'all' variant is the Total group of the ED Diagnoses grouper: every ED encounter, including diagnoses not shown as their own group, and not a total of the other variants. The 'other' variant is the grouper's Other group: ED encounters for other mental health reasons.
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}.statement: In {location}, the median {variant.short_name} ED encounter lasted {value} minutes.

epic_ed_los_median_{variant}_suppressed_.short_name: Suppressed flag: median ED length of stay, {variant.short_name}
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}_suppressed_.long_name: Suppression flag for the {variant.short_name} median ED length of stay
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}_suppressed_.short_description: Indicates whether the {variant.short_name} median ED length of stay was suppressed at source.
epic_ed_los_median_{variant}_suppressed_.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the {variant.short_name} median ED length of stay (the cell was built on 10 or fewer encounters) and the value is left missing; 0 when a value was published.

epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}.long_name: First-quartile (25th percentile) emergency department length of stay for {variant.short_name} encounters
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}.short_description: Time in minutes from ED arrival to ED departure that 25% of {variant.short_name} encounters fall under.
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}.long_description: First quartile (25th percentile) of emergency department length of stay in minutes for {variant.short_name} encounters: one quarter of encounters ended in less time than this. Same population, attribution, boarding-time and suppression handling as epic_ed_los_median_{variant}. Read with the median and epic_ed_los_q3_{variant} it describes the spread of stays.
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}.statement: In {location}, one quarter of {variant.short_name} ED encounters lasted under {value} minutes.

epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}_suppressed_flag.short_name: Suppressed flag: first-quartile ED length of stay, {variant.short_name}
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}_suppressed_flag.long_name: Suppression flag for the {variant.short_name} first-quartile ED length of stay
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}_suppressed_flag.short_description: Indicates whether the {variant.short_name} first-quartile ED length of stay was suppressed at source.
epic_ed_los_q1_{variant}_suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the {variant.short_name} first-quartile ED length of stay (10 or fewer encounters) and the value is left missing; 0 when a value was published.

epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}.long_name: Third-quartile (75th percentile) emergency department length of stay for {variant.short_name} encounters
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}.short_description: Time in minutes from ED arrival to ED departure that 75% of {variant.short_name} encounters fall under.
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}.long_description: Third quartile (75th percentile) of emergency department length of stay in minutes for {variant.short_name} encounters: three quarters of encounters ended in less time than this, so the longest quarter of stays - the boarders - sit above it. Same population, attribution, boarding-time and suppression handling as epic_ed_los_median_{variant}.
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}.statement: In {location}, three quarters of {variant.short_name} ED encounters lasted under {value} minutes.

epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}_suppressed_flag.short_name: Suppressed flag: third-quartile ED length of stay, {variant.short_name}
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}_suppressed_flag.long_name: Suppression flag for the {variant.short_name} third-quartile ED length of stay
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}_suppressed_flag.short_description: Indicates whether the {variant.short_name} third-quartile ED length of stay was suppressed at source.
epic_ed_los_q3_{variant}_suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the {variant.short_name} third-quartile ED length of stay (10 or fewer encounters) and the value is left missing; 0 when a value was published.

epic_ed_n_visits.long_name: Number of emergency department visits, all encounters
epic_ed_n_visits.short_description: Number of Epic Cosmos ED encounters, for any diagnosis, in the geography, quarter and age band.
epic_ed_n_visits.long_description: Number of Epic Cosmos emergency department encounters with a United States country of residence attributed to the patient's state of residence and the calendar quarter of arrival. Cells of 10 or fewer encounters are suppressed at source and imputed as 5, with the flag set to 1. It covers all ED encounters, not only the mental health diagnoses.

epic_ed_n_visits_{variant}.long_name: Number of emergency department visits with a {variant.short_name} diagnosis
epic_ed_n_visits_{variant}.short_description: Number of Epic Cosmos ED encounters in the {variant.short_name} diagnosis group in the geography, quarter and age band.
epic_ed_n_visits_{variant}.long_description: Number of Epic Cosmos emergency department encounters with a United States country of residence assigned to the {variant.short_name} group of the ED Diagnoses grouper, attributed to the patient's state of residence and the calendar quarter of arrival. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed at source and imputed as 5, with the flag set to 1. The grouper's groups are not guaranteed to be mutually exclusive, and the age bands do not add up to 'Overall'. Divide by epic_ed_n_visits for the share of all ED encounters; imputed cells make small shares approximate.
epic_ed_n_visits_{variant}.statement: In {location}, there were {value} ED visits for {variant.short_name}.

epic_ed_n_visits_{variant}_suppressed_fl.long_name: Suppression flag for the {variant.short_name} ED visit count
epic_ed_n_visits_{variant}_suppressed_fl.short_description: Indicates whether the {variant.short_name} ED visit count was suppressed and imputed as 5.
epic_ed_n_visits_{variant}_suppressed_fl.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos reported '10 or fewer' for the cell and the count was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise.

epic_ed_n_visits_suppressed_flag.long_name: Suppression flag for the all-encounter ED visit count
epic_ed_n_visits_suppressed_flag.short_description: Indicates whether the ED visit count was suppressed and imputed as 5.
epic_ed_n_visits_suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos reported '10 or fewer' for the cell and the count was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise.

age.long_name: Age at time of ED visit
age.short_description: Age band of the patient at the time of the emergency department visit.
age.long_description: Age at the time of the visit, in bands: 0-9, 10-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-44, 45-64 and 65+. '0-24' is the exported under-25 band; it overlaps the bands below it.

epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. The dataset includes emergency department visits, diagnoses, immunizations, laboratory results, and other clinical data. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed. Coverage extends across all U.S. states and territories. ICD-10 codes for mental health diagnoses were obtained from paper Zima BT, Gay JC, Rodean J, et al. Classification System for International Classification of Diseases, Ninth Revision, Clinical Modification and Tenth Revision Pediatric Mental Health Disorders. JAMA Pediatr. 2020;174(6):620–622. doi:10.1001/jamapediatrics.2020.0037
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'
